::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/prices/{price}/applicable_addons"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `price` | `string` | **yes** | The price's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro-monthly-usd`). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `price` | `string` | The plan price you asked about. |
| `plan` | `string` | The plan that price belongs to. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The applicable add-ons and charges. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.item` | `string` | The attached add-on or charge product |
| `data.plan` | `string` | The plan's product id (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |
| `data.kind` | `string` | The attached item's kind. One of `addon`, `charge`. |
| `data.active` | `boolean` | True if the attached item is active. |
| `data.source` | `string` | Whether the item is attached directly or through a differential price. One of `attached`, `differential`, `all`. |
| `data.applicability` | `string` | How the plan treats the item: mandatory, recommended or optional. One of `mandatory`, `recommended`, `optional`. |
| `data.charge_on_event` | `string` | The event that charges the item. |
| `data.charge_once` | `boolean` | True if the item is charged once instead of every period. |
| `data.default_quantity` | `integer` | The quantity used when none is given. |
| `data.billing_cycles` | `integer` | How many billing cycles the item is charged for. |
| `data.min_quantity` | `integer` | Portal-only minimum. |
| `data.max_quantity` | `integer` | Portal-only maximum. |
| `data.quantity_step` | `integer` | Portal-only quantity step. |
| `data.customer_can_change_quantity` | `boolean` | Whether customers can change the quantity in the portal. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A list of attached_item objects |
| `400` | Not a plan price |
| `404` | No such price |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/prices/pro-monthly-usd/applicable_addons" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
